title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of Hf-Nb-Ta-Ti-Zr refractory high-entropy alloys fabricated by laser directed energy deposition
process_description: prepared by laser directed energy deposition (LDED) with 2500W laser power, 10mm/s scanning speed, 5.0mm deposited layer width, 2.2mm layer height, 50% overlap, and 0.25mm up-lift height under argon atmosphere (oxygen ≤100ppm). Spherical pre-alloyed powders (45-90μm) used.

title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of Hf-Nb-Ta-Ti-Zr refractory high-entropy alloys fabricated by laser directed energy deposition
process_description: prepared by laser directed energy deposition (LDED) with 3000W laser power, 15mm/s scanning speed, 5.4mm deposited layer width, 1.8mm layer height, 50% overlap, and 0.25mm up-lift height under argon atmosphere (oxygen ≤100ppm). Spherical pre-alloyed powders (45-90μm) used.
